title: Install and verify Clew
summary: Install the Clew CLI and matching provider, initialize its private ledger, and verify the retained Platter lookup interface without adding application records.

consumers.statement: The authorized local installer and Cell deployment coordinator.

preconditions.statement: A green committed Clew candidate and a compatible installed Platter opportunity reader are available.

inputs.statement: Use deploy.sh plan clew then deploy.sh clew from committed local main. Clew accepts no deployment settings. Direct program installation accepts absolute --binary, --bundle and optional --home.

outputs.statement: The selected immutable release contains clew, clew-install and the matching Chancery provider. Coordinated configure initializes empty schema-one state.

data_semantics.statement: Installation is program selection and empty-ledger initialization. It creates no application entries and supplies no statuses.

identity_and_units.statement: Content hashes identify immutable releases; package version, provider contract and database schema are separate identities.

completeness_and_freshness.statement: Verification checks the selected installed bytes, local ledger integrity and the retained Platter read interface at that invocation. It establishes no future availability.

access.statement: The current user owns installation selectors and private ledger state.

lifecycle_and_consistency.statement: The shared file transaction publishes command/provider selectors atomically. Schema-one ledger rows are preserved separately through program upgrades and file recovery. No scheduler, service or state migration is installed.

operational_limits.statement: There is no completion-time guarantee. Concurrent schema-one readers and short SQLite writers can finish across program selection.

compatibility_and_evolution.statement: Only cell-install-v2 releases and Clew state schema one are supported. Incompatible state migration is not supplied.

reliances.statement: Clew requires the Platter opportunity reader for first-reference admission and search.

use_when: Installing, checking or recovering the Clew command and private ledger.
do_not_use_when: Recording an application update or changing Platter preparation.
outcome: Verified installed Clew commands, provider and compatible empty or existing ledger.
effects: Program deployment selects immutable files and initializes a missing ledger without creating entries. Existing rows remain intact.
authority: Clew owns its installation and ledger; the shared coordinator owns deployment ordering.
success: Installed bytes match the selected candidate, ledger integrity passes and the retained Platter read interface succeeds.
failure_and_recovery: File recovery selects a coherent prior or candidate release without restoring or deleting the ledger. Preserve unresolved installation evidence. Unsupported or nonempty foreign state fails.
privacy: Private ledger state is outside source and installation releases.
does_not_authorize: Adding application records, deleting ledger history, sending mail or enabling a schedule.
